title: MirrorGuard: Toward Secure Computer-Use Agents via Simulation-to-Real Reasoning Correction
reasoning: The paper includes an 'Ethical Considerations' section, but it serves as a standard disclaimer rather than a core component of evaluating or benchmarking the agent's inherent moral reasoning, religious understanding, or broader ethical framework. While it addresses 'Hate, Harassment & Bias' as a risk category, this focuses on preventing harmful content generation and actions by the agent, not an intrinsic evaluation of its ethics or faith.
